$comment: Machine-readable module graph for agents (Undertow v1.0, local-only). Planners assign work items to modules so parallel builders never share files; reviewers use depends_on/used_by to find what a change can break; the verify step uses tests + shared_resources. Keep in sync when adding a module (see docs/AGENT_PROCESS.md). Every repo file matches exactly one module path (dirs end in /); a module owns its own test files, and tests lists what to run.

shared_resources.docker_api_image: Building/running the api image (`docker compose build api`, `docker compose run --rm api ...`). One agent at a time: parallel builds collide.
shared_resources.next_dot_dir: frontend/.next. `next build` clobbers the running dev server; only the serialized verify step may build, after stopping the dev server.
shared_resources.postgres_db: The live dev database (docker volume pgdata). Schema changes go through db._add_missing_columns (nullable columns only).
shared_resources.shared_hotspots: Files many features touch: backend/app/main.py, backend/app/models.py, backend/app/config.py, frontend/src/lib/api.ts, frontend/src/components/Nav.tsx, frontend/src/app/globals.css. At most one builder per wave may edit each; globals.css may be appended by several only under their own /* --- Section --- */ header.
shared_resources.smtp_provider: The SMTP account behind email delivery (SMTP_* env). Tests never send (FakeTransport); never point a dev or test run at a real list.

modules.summary: FastAPI routes (incl. /api/paper-portfolio (hypothetical, cached 10 min), /api/newsletter/*, /api/tickers/sitemap, /api/research/studies, /api/journal/chain|verify, /api/health/details|history, /api/vault/status|notes (thesis read-back, cached 60 s) and admin POST /api/vault/export, public read-only GET /api/graph (event graph via app.graph.build_graph, vault evidence fn when the study is loaded); mounts the delivery router), rate-limit middleware + admin dependency wiring, lifespan (load_study + load_forward_evidence), to_out (main vs forward-test EvidenceOut), scheduler loops (slow: ingest, borrow snapshot, journal, seal_cycle, vault_cycle (throttled to VAULT_EXPORT_MINUTES, forced after new seals and once at startup, EXPORT_LOCK), newsletter_cycle (+ email), digest_cycle, uptime_cycle; fast: EDGAR + live Form 4 forward-test poller + halts), AppState (incl. paper_cache, forward_evidence, vault_last_run/vault_due/vault_notes_cache). Vault* and Graph* schema models. Optional schema fields: SignalOut/ArticleOut.forward_test, EvidenceOut, Paper* models. research_jobs.MODULES: backtest, event_study, event_study_oos, insider_study.

Settings (env; local zero-config defaults: PUBLIC_BASE_URL = site origin http://localhost:3000, every integration off until set) incl. AdminSettings (ADMIN_TOKEN, RESEARCH_JOBS_ENABLED, MUTATIONS_ENABLED), rate-limit settings and VAULT_* settings, engine/session, stopgap column migration, all ORM tables (incl. subscribers, email_sends). test_config_local.py checks the zero-config local defaults.
RSS, EDGAR multi-form feeds + filing text, Alpaca news, Nasdaq halts.

Ingest cycle, fast EDGAR poll (+ _poll_form4 hook for the live insider forward test), store_and_publish, NEW_ARTICLE_HOOKS, dedupe, ticker tagging, company sizes, signal taxonomy (ALL_SIGNALS for the main study; FORWARD_TEST_SIGNALS outside it; signal_def()), LLM enrichment, SSE.

Edge Lab event study (StudyDesign/run_design, firm-clustered t, --offline replay), pre-registered out-of-sample study (oos.py, PREREGISTRATION_OOS.md), hash-only input manifests and canonical compare (snapshot.py), Yahoo price loader (raw/adjusted prices, split unadjusting). paper_numbers.py: HEADLINE claims of docs/paper/WORKING_PAPER.md checked against docs/results (test needs the repo at /repo, mounted by scripts/pytest.sh).
Portfolio backtester, run log, readiness gates, IBKR borrow archiver.

Forward signal journal (track record), daily marking, per-signal evaluation horizons (EVALUATION_HORIZONS: 5 days for insider_cluster_purchase, else 20) and forward-test labels, live-vs-expected summary, tamper-evident daily SHA-256 hash chain (digest.py, {data_dir}/journal_chain.jsonl).

Hypothetical paper portfolio simulated from the forward journal (service.build_portfolio): one fixed-notional position per entry, side from the prior direction, evaluation horizon from journal.service, costs/borrow imported from research and backtest, cache-only prices, optional IWM hedge. No execution code (test greps for it). Served by GET /api/paper-portfolio in main.py.
Discord alerts for signal filings and halts, alert log with detection latency.
Cash runway, share dilution, offering history (SEC XBRL), FINRA short interest.
Weekly Small-Cap Filing Radar: build, render Markdown/HTML, immutable file archive ({data_dir}/newsletters/), journal seal line (track_record.seal), CLI (python -m app.newsletter.build).

Email delivery, off unless SMTP_HOST + EMAIL_FROM + EMAIL_POSTAL_ADDRESS: double opt-in list (subscribers, email_sends), idempotent newsletter fan-out and daily digest, SMTP/Fake transports, public /api/subscribe|unsubscribe|subscription/daily|delivery/status router. Own DeliverySettings (SMTP_*, EMAIL_*).

Obsidian vault export: plain Markdown only under <VAULT_DIR>/Undertow/ (Tickers, Signals, Journal (sealed fields), Briefs, Studies, Newsletter, Paper copy, Bases/*.base, in-vault AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, index.md, append-only log.md, _conflicts/). VaultFS path confinement, atomic write-if-changed, never deletes; fence/hash conflicts; read_theses (thesis notes outside Undertow/); {data_dir}/vault_state.json. Never imports app.main, never reads Settings. working_paper.md is a byte-identical copy of docs/paper/WORKING_PAPER.md (test needs /repo). Wired by vault_cycle and /api/vault/* in main.py.

Separate pre-registered Form 4 insider-purchase event study: SEC insider data sets, safe Form 4 XML parser, CMP routine/opportunistic classifier, writes {data_dir}/event_study_insider_purchases.json (python -m app.insiders.study). Plus the live forward test of its one significant cell (micro insider_cluster_purchase, 5 days): live.py polls EDGAR Form 4 in the fast loop (INSIDER_LIVE_ENABLED, settings.py), applies the study's own rules, emits forward-test articles via pipeline.ingest.store_and_publish; evidence.py serves the frozen evidence row. Never adds to ALL_SIGNALS.

Event graph engine (build_graph, GraphParams, clear_cache): recent Article rows -> TF-IDF (1-2 grams) -> GNN-style neighbourhood smoothing (not a trained GNN) -> contextual / spatial (same ticker, same size bucket) / temporal edges -> deterministic Louvain clusters -> c-TF-IDF names (optional cached Claude names when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set, {data_dir}/graph_names.json), cluster stats, evidence, timeline, 300 s TTL cache. Edges are associations / proximity, not causes. Stdlib + SQLAlchemy only (no numpy/sklearn/networkx; test greps), never imports app.main. Adapted from University of Louisville work (arXiv 2408.11133, 2602.02601). Served by GET /api/graph in main.py.

Admin policy for every mutating endpoint (token > env flag > local-only) and per-client sliding-window rate limiter (security.py); deep health evaluation and uptime history in {data_dir}/uptime.jsonl (health.py). main.py wires both.

Browser API client + types (mirror backend, incl. Graph* types + api.graph; ApiError, admin token helpers, send() for writes), formatting helpers, nav (News at /news, Graph, Paper, Learn, Research tabs; isActive()), footer (Working paper/Paper portfolio/Event graph/Methodology/Subscribe/Status links, admin-error notice), layout, global styles/tokens. next.config.ts sets output: standalone. server-api.ts belongs to fe_ticker.

Landing page / (server component; Key findings cards from the three study endpoints via components/home/findings.ts, KeyFindings.tsx), /news (NewsFeed, moved from /), Signals page and its cards (forward-test badge + in-sample hypothetical evidence line).

Server-rendered SEO ticker pages ((view)/ route group, 404 gate, summary.ts, TickerView "View in event graph" link to /graph?ticker=, client VaultNotes panel with the user's Obsidian thesis notes via api.vaultNotes, plain text), server-side fetch helpers + SITE_URL (server-api.ts, also used by the newsletter and Learn pages: getEventStudy, getBacktestReport), sitemap.xml (incl. /learn pages from lib/learn/lessons.ts), robots.txt.
Edge Lab (study selector main/oos/insider_purchases, OOS comparison + confirmatory verdicts), Backtest and Track record pages (incl. SealPanel) and their charts.

/paper: hypothetical paper portfolio (server shell + client PaperPortfolioView, EquityChart): tiles, equity curve, per-signal table, recent positions, assumptions, always showing the backend label. Paper-only: no order, broker or account UI.

Methodology (incl. the Event graph section: method, UofL credits, association-not-cause), legal drafts, server-rendered newsletter archive and issue pages (/newsletter, /newsletter/[issue]) with the SubscribeForm client island, /research index, /research/paper (working paper from src/content/working-paper.md, a byte-identical copy of docs/paper/WORKING_PAPER.md, rendered by the safe components/markdown/ renderer; no dangerouslySetInnerHTML), /trading -> /paper redirect.

Server-rendered Learn section: /learn index, /learn/[slug] (6 lessons, static params, ISR 1 h, live numbers via server-api), /learn/curriculum (8 weeks); client widgets/simulators with seeded PRNG (lib/learn/stats.ts, simulations.ts), lesson registry (lessons.ts), live-number helpers (live.ts). ConfirmatoryBlock/parts are also used by the Edge Lab.

/graph: server wrapper (metadata) + client GraphExplorer (?ticker=&days=&source=&max_nodes=): canvas force layout (force.ts, GraphCanvas; honours prefers-reduced-motion), ClusterLegend, NodeDetail, TimeScrubber replay, HowItWorks (method + UofL credit, association-not-causation note), graph.module.css. Reads api.graph.

/status: health components, 7-day uptime, incidents, journal seal verification, the Obsidian vault card (api.vaultStatus, Export now via admin api.vaultExport, conflict count), and the admin-token box (session storage, shared with ResearchRunPanel via api.ts get/setAdminToken).

Research docs (feasibility, product research kept as background after the 2026-10-19 local-only decision), published results, the working paper (docs/paper/), batch plans, this graph, process doc, README, and the shared guides/env examples owned by the workflow's final docs node (SHARED_DOCS in feature-graph.js).

Agent tooling and local infra: scripts/start.ps1 (Windows one-command local start), scripts/pytest.sh (parallel-safe tests on mounted source: backend/ at /app, repo read-only at /repo), scripts/reproduce.sh (offline study replay + compare), Makefile shortcuts, feature-graph workflow, preview config, local compose file (web profile) and the optional, for-later prod compose file, api and web Dockerfiles, CI workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml), ignore/attributes rules, api requirements, pytest config and conftest.
